title: Leonida Legends
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation 5 list, frozen 18 November 2026. Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry from the official description and the PSN progress targets; where a method is not confirmed yet, the guide says so instead of inventing a place or a step.

roadmap.title: Finish the story
roadmap.text: Play Chapters 1 to 4 and the final mission. Story trophies unlock as you go, so just keep playing and enjoy it — nothing here needs grinding.

roadmap.title: Strangers across Leonida
roadmap.text: Pick up the stranger mission strands around the state and see each one through to its final mission: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, plus eight strands in total.

roadmap.title: Activities and skills
roadmap.text: Try every activity once, then chase the skill trophies: 250 stunts, gold at every Shooting Range challenge, drone races at all locations, 20 different race wins, fishing against Cal, an arcade game, and bowling.

roadmap.title: Collect Leonida
roadmap.text: Sweep the map for the long collections: card sets, WAiNK spots, vehicles, meditation spots and every corner of the state. Meditate at each spot the moment you find it — it is the one trophy that may not wait for you.

roadmap.title: Money and mayhem
roadmap.text: Fund the platinum the Leonida way: rob shops, vaults, trucks and gang operations, launder marked bills through your contacts, buy every garage, and spend big across the shops.

roadmap.title: The road to Platinum
roadmap.text: Mop up the last counters — 50 challenges and 100% completion — and the Platinum, Vice Got a Price!, pops the moment the other 54 are yours.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum is automatic: it unlocks the moment you hold the other 54 trophies. There is nothing extra to do for it, so treat the rest of this guide as the checklist and work through it stage by stage.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the Gone Fishing mission. It is an early story mission, so it comes to you naturally in Chapter 1 — no detour needed, just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies are unmissable story progress — finish every mission the chapter hands you and this pops at the chapter's close.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Like every chapter trophy, it is story progress you cannot miss — clear the chapter's missions in order and it unlocks at the close.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. Chapter trophies follow the story, so there is no special requirement — finish the chapter and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and like the others it is pure story progress — no grinding, no side requirement.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. It is the gold story trophy and it cannot be missed — reach the end of the campaign and it pops. Keep a save from before the finale if you want to revisit the ending choice afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks by playing the campaign — follow the mission markers when it appears and finish it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission. Named story missions like this one come to you as the campaign unfolds; play the mission through and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. Another named story mission — it arrives in the campaign on its own, so keep following the story and finish it when it shows up.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. Story missions are unmissable by design — play the campaign until Headliners appears, then see it through to the end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. It is a story mission at the airport, so it unlocks through campaign progress — finish the mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission. A named story mission like the rest of this set — keep playing the campaign and clear it when it arrives.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the game's own checklist of story, side missions, activities and collectibles. PSNProfiles lists the counter as 0/100. Save this for last: it is the natural finish line once every other trophy is done, and the in-game stats screen shows what is still missing.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long air time and the like, tracked by the game's stunt counter. PSNProfiles lists the target as 0/250. The fastest way is to keep a fast car or bike handy and chain jumps off ramps and hills while travelling between missions; the counter climbs in normal play, so do not grind it in one sitting.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity at least once. PSNProfiles counts 9 activity types (0/9), so the trick is breadth, not mastery: sample each one — a race, a shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling and the rest — and the trophy pops when the last type is ticked off.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge. PSNProfiles lists 42 challenges (0/42), so this is a long one — treat it as a range session, not a sprint. Learn each challenge's target pattern first, then go for gold; the range is open from early on, so you can chip away at it between story missions.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. PSNProfiles lists the counter as 0/14. Drone races are about smooth lines through the gates rather than raw speed — learn each course's gate order, cut corners where the gates allow, and take them one location at a time.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same one twenty times. PSNProfiles lists the counter as 0/20. Enter a spread of race types across the map, pick a vehicle class you are comfortable with, and work through the list; wins in new events count, repeats do not.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so it is about out-catching him rather than just catching fish: keep your line in the water, watch the tension so you do not snap it, and reel steadily when a fish bites. If Cal wins the first round, try again — the challenge can be repeated.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade cabinet, not just start one. Pick a cabinet you enjoy, learn its controls for a round or two, and play it through to the end screen.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Stranger missions appear as icons around Leonida — meet Andy, work through his jobs in order, and the strand ends with this trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand by completing his final mission. Find Kenton out in the world, take his jobs as they come, and the strand closes with this trophy at the end of his last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Billy's jobs show up as you explore Leonida — follow the strand through each mission and the finale pops this trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. PSNProfiles lists the counter as 0/8. Each strand is a small chain of missions for one stranger — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and more — so keep an eye out for stranger icons while you travel, start every strand you find, and finish each one to the end.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Meet Randy, work his jobs in order, and the strand's last mission closes it out with this trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand by completing his final mission. Tyrone's jobs appear as you move around the state — take them in order and the final mission ends the strand with this trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — PSNProfiles lists the counter as 0/18. This is the one trophy flagged as possibly missable: meditate at every spot the moment you find it, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, because a spot tied to an early chapter area may not be reachable later and there is no confirmed mission replay. Every other trophy in this guide can be earned after the story.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is a hunting job: track the animal he names, move quietly, and take the shot when you have a clear one. The animal is unique, so if you spook it, back off and try the approach again rather than chasing it across the map.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. PSNProfiles lists the counter as 0/3. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, in the world and as rewards — so pick up every card you see and trade or buy the missing ones; a set only counts when every card in it is yours.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations — the in-game check-in style collectible, counted by PSNProfiles as 0/100. This is a sweep-the-map trophy: hit WAiNK spots as you pass them during other stages, and save a final pass for the ones left over once the story is done.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's open checklist of small feats, counted by PSNProfiles as 0/50. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more, and many complete themselves while you chase other trophies. Check the challenges list late in the run and pick off the cheapest ones left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Get the heat up together — cause chaos until four stars show — then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and stay out of the search cones until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner in the car is the whole point, so do not ditch them mid-chase.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Pick three shops close together, plan the route before the first robbery, and move fast between them — the wanted level must stay active from the first till to the third, so do not lose the cops in between.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in and drive them, and the game logs each new one. PSNProfiles lists the counter as 0/100. Variety is the way: try every car, bike, boat and truck you pass instead of sticking to one favourite, and the counter climbs fast in normal play.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster — a gang shootout or a wanted-level fight — trigger Combat Focus with a group in front of you, and chain the takedowns before it ends. If the group is too thin, raise the heat first, then try again.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA — the airport. In plain terms: get to the airfield, grab a plane, and take off without going through the front door. Expect security to object, so go in fast, get airborne, and leave the runway behind you.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get behind the controls of a Rhino tank — the description's joke is the hint. Rhinos turn up where the military does, so look for them at high wanted levels or military spots, climb in, and enjoy the ride; simply driving one is the heart of it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This one is stealth: case the store first, go in quiet, take the goods without tripping an alarm or being spotted, and slip out before anyone raises it. If you are seen, leave and try again — detection voids the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. PSNProfiles lists the counter as 0/5. Bank jobs are the heavy robberies — plan the approach, crack the vault, grab the take, and have a getaway vehicle ready, because the escape counts as much as the robbery.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around the state — find one on the road, stop it, break it open, take the cash, and lose the wanted level that follows. A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape much easier.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. PSNProfiles lists the counter as 0/52 — the state's regions and landmarks. Drive, fly and sail into every corner: cities, coast, swamps and backroads. The in-game map fills in as you go, so the blank patches are your to-do list.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. PSNProfiles lists the counter as 0/9, so there are nine gangs to hit. Find each gang's operation, rob it, and get out — one per gang, and the trophy pops when the last gang's operation is yours.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or spot overlooking Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view — it is a quiet moment trophy, so slow down, sit where the ocean is in front of you, and let the scene play.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom — in classic style, meaning through the glass in a car. Drive into a showroom, pick a car, and floor it straight out through the front. The showroom's loss is your trophy.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to the alley, pick up a ball, and bowl a proper game — follow-through and all. It is an activity trophy, so one finished visit is all it takes.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal — a social, partner-driven trophy. The official description is deliberately vague, so the honest read is: keep doing activities with your partner and watch the partnership's public standing climb. No launch-era guide pins down an exact number yet, so treat it as a play-together goal rather than a checklist item.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — for better or worse. PSNProfiles lists a counter of 0/500, so this is about the volume of decisions across the game rather than one big choice. Play the story and the side content, pick a side whenever the game asks, and the counter climbs on its own.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — retry something and get it right on the second attempt. The description is cryptic by design, so the practical read is: when a mission or challenge fails, retry it straight away and finish it. It pops on a successful second try somewhere in the campaign.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This is the game's odd-moment trophy — something strange in Leonida that you stumble into rather than chase. Keep your eyes open while exploring, especially off the beaten path, and the moment will find you.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by — knock targets down with a melee swing from a moving vehicle, like pins. Find a group on foot, line up a slow pass, and swing as you roll by. A bike or a slow car gives you the best aim.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. PSNProfiles lists the counter as 0/250000. Marked bills come from robberies — bank vaults, trucks and gang operations — so this pairs naturally with the robbery trophies: rob, launder the bills through a contact, and bank the clean cut until the quarter-million is reached.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. PSNProfiles lists the counter as 0/100000. It counts spending everywhere — clothes, weapons, cars, food — so it climbs on its own as you gear up. Late in the run, buy the big-ticket items you have been putting off and it pops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. PSNProfiles lists the counter as 0/8. Garages go on sale as you progress and earn — buy each one as it becomes available rather than saving them all for the end, and the last purchase pops the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. PSNProfiles lists the counter as 0/10. Find ten vehicles worth keeping, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one — it pairs with Whip It Good, since every new discovery is a candidate for the app.
